title: Translated archive slugs must be discovered, not generated by suffix replacement

evidence.heading: Verified French v20 document reached through the archive index chain

disposition: Corrected in this publication: legacy locale URLs are traced from the archive root through exact-edition directory links and matched by document ID and language. All 34 failed generated guesses were superseded by verified translated locations; their original 404 results remain in source URL history. This was a discovery error in this catalog, not a 4D product defect. The initial three candidate changes and their English/Japanese evidence are unchanged; this correction does not imply additional content review. The tracking issue closes when the foundation PR is merged.
